Hi Sarah / team —

Quick follow on the 20% pilot discount you requested earlier this month. Finance flagged the line as "uncommitted" in the forecast because we don't yet have an approved Deal Desk ticket or PO in the system. Before EOD Wednesday we need either: (a) an approved Deal Desk clearance note, or (b) a signed PO so we can mark this as committed revenue in July.

Action items:
- Sarah: can you confirm whether Procurement will issue the PO this week? If not, can you confirm expected PO date and whether the 20% is still required?
- Laura / Rishi: please confirm whether Deal Desk has authorized the 20% or whether we need to route for approval (I can escalate).
- Vanessa: if we don't have a PO, can Finance keep a placeholder but mark as "commit pending" rather than committed? We need accurate headroom for the July forecast.

I attached the discount request and our proposed SOW redlines for reference.

Thanks —Marcus
Marcus Lin
Account Exec, Mid-Market Sales

Marcus —

Thanks for the heads up. Procurement is reviewing the paperwork today; the PO is contingent on final legal sign-off on the SOW redlines (one clause about data retention). We are pushing to get a PO by Friday 7/9 but I can't promise earlier.

On the discount: our execs approved the 20% for the pilot conditional on a 6-month commitment; we would prefer not to reduce it. If Deal Desk needs to re-evaluate, let me know what evidence they need.

FYI I've looped in Alex from VendorPay to confirm timing on our PO system side (they help with our purchase order automation).

—Sarah

- Re-run the quota forecast for July to show impact of $0 vs committed $ (I can coordinate with Ops).

Vanessa, per our cadence: can you capture a "pending" placeholder amount so we preserve headroom but avoid over-reporting committed revenue? Please add a comment in the forecast explaining the dependency on legal/PO.

Marcus — please keep pushing Procurement for the PO. If you want Rishi to route Deal Desk approval now (email thread documenting approval), say the word and he'll take it.

Thanks —Laura
